title: Conditional A2 gradient-flow baseline versus the R-192 production heat/root owner

a2_owner.functional: hash-pinned A1 P1 reference functional with eta_shell=0

erase the R-192 first failure slot
treat the conditional A2-H3 theorem as an unconditional physical dynamics
promote fixed-torus decay to a physical-empty, thermodynamic or continuum conclusion
insert a raw-current or q-ledger field not present in the A2 authority
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing owner crosswalk only.
